decision_rule: Battery R5 line rules (R3/R4 error definitions). A line is corrected if any fact is not on a stated row of that plant (or a company row worded company-wide), is at the wrong site, or is misdated: a board re-post stamp written as a posting date, an aggregator or expired copy written as live, a date the row does not carry, or a relative-time clause left without its date. It is also corrected if it writes a plan as progress, uses a live count, puts an older fact first, rests on a premise no row states, lacks the closing 'you' question (opening lines), or gives an unhedged bottleneck guess. A clause on the source page but on no row is corrected. Unreachable means a clause rests only on a source that cannot be reached. A clause whose stated row cites an unreachable aggregator, but whose text was re-read today on the company's own live board, is confirmed and reported as a citation gap. 'listed <date>' and 'read <date>' are allowed per the coordinator rule of 2026-11-17. Carve-out (BAE): a question's premise counts as stated when stated rows of the plant carry it in their own fields. BAE's six stated requisition rows are titled for trade-school partners (J-Tech, UTI-Miramar, Tidewater Tech, FCTC), which supports 'training welders' even though no row quote carries the page's training sentence.
